name: io.github.burmanharry/rootmention
title: RootMention
description: SEO subscription that gets brands named by ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. $299/mo.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Read RootMention service scope, pricing and public links.

tools.name: calculate_seo_break_even
tools.description: Estimate incremental orders and visits needed to cover monthly SEO spend. A scenario calculation, not a forecast.

tools.name: run_seo_audit
tools.description: Audit a public homepage and up to two discovered product/collection pages. Requires user authorization. Respects robots.txt; returns findings inline without saving a report or sales lead. Maximum 35 seconds, three attempts per IP per hour, 30 shared audit attempts per hour.

authorized.description: True only when the user confirms they own or are authorized to audit the website.
